instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use HTML, CSS (Tailwind classes permitted via script tag), and Vanilla JavaScript ONLY. Do not use React or Shadcn.
Include Phosphor icons script: ``. Use icons like ``.
Configure Tailwind in the head script to use Cabinet Grotesk for 'sans' headings and Satoshi for body.
Convert all heavy text into infographic-style chunks. For example, turn the recruitment process into a 5-step horizontal or vertical timeline.
For the Jobs section, create clean, minimal cards featuring the job title, 3 key skills as minimalist pills (e.g., border border-gray-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs), and a minimalist 'Apply Now' CTA.
Use CSS Grid with 1px gaps on a gray background (bg-gray-200) for the features section to create a seamless border structure ('Technical Look' from Archetype 4). Children elements get bg-white.
Do not use border-radius (rounded-none). The corporate minimal look relies on sharp edges for Archetype 4.
All interactive elements (buttons, job links) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='apply-php-developer').
Integrate the generated media URLs as large structural images (for Hero, Benefits, and Process sections) using `object-cover` and grayscale hover transitions to blend the orange accents nicely.
